description: The full HTTP service and domain logic on top of FEAT-001: products + carts services, the Fastify app factory and error handler, checkout+orders with idempotency, coupons (generation + reserve/commit/release state machine), and the read-only reconciling report. This is the heart of the assignment -- every graded invariant (no oversell, at-most-once checkout, idempotent retry, single coupon redemption, reserve-then-commit, milestone-at-most-once, reconciling report) is enforced here. Depends on FEAT-001. Grounded in design.md Sections 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12. Folds in F1 (R-REPORT-SYNC synchronous buildReport), F2 (orders.size single source; milestoneSequence=orders.size after insert), F3 (fingerprint cartId|couponCode + immutable-cart assumption), F4 (no reservedBy), F5 (randomUUID ids; API-created carts), NIT a (executor.run with no preceding await), NIT b (admin coupons list includes status). Includes per-module integration tests via app.inject().
steps: Create c:\...\be\src\http\app.ts (buildApp({store,config,yieldHook?}) returning a Fastify instance with routes + error handler registered) and c:\...\be\src\http\error-handler.ts (setErrorHandler mapping AppError -> {error:{code,message,details?}} + httpStatus; zod errors -> VALIDATION_ERROR 400; unexpected -> 500 INTERNAL_ERROR with no stack leak). Create c:\...\be\src\server.ts (loadConfig, seed store, buildApp, listen -- the documented seeded start command).
Create c:\...\be\src\domain\products.ts (listProducts, getProduct -> PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND 404) and c:\...\be\src\http\routes\products.ts (GET /products, GET /products/:id).

Create c:\...\be\src\domain\carts.ts: create (randomUUID id), addItem (sum qty on duplicate product, re-validate cap), updateQty (absolute, >=1), removeItem (idempotent no-op if absent), view (decorate lines with current price + lineSubtotal + cart subtotal). All mutations run through executor; require status 'open' else CART_ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT 409; validation per design 5.2/6.1 (PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND 404, INVALID_QUANTITY 400). Create c:\...\be\src\http\routes\carts.ts (POST /carts, GET /carts/:id, POST/PATCH/DELETE items).

Create c:\...\be\src\domain\checkout.ts implementing design 7.2 as ONE executor task: (1) if Idempotency-Key present, look up by key FIRST, fingerprint = `${cartId}|${couponCode ?? ''}` (F3) -> match replay 200 Idempotent-Replay:true / differs IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED 422 / none fall through; (2) load cart (CART_NOT_FOUND 404), if checked_out do header-less couponCode comparison -> 200 replay or 409 CART_ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT; (3) CART_EMPTY 422; (4) reserve coupon FIRST if supplied (COUPON_NOT_FOUND 422 / COUPON_NOT_REDEEMABLE 409); (5) validate each line fresh, capture current unitPriceCents, no mutation (PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE 409 / INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY 409, release coupon on failure); (6) compute subtotal + clamped discount; (7) commit: decrement inventory, insert order then set milestoneSequence = orders.size AFTER insert (F2), redeem coupon, mark cart checked_out, write idempotency record (commit only); release coupon on ANY pre-commit failure. Create c:\...\be\src\http\routes\checkout.ts (handler calls executor.run(...) with NO preceding await -- NIT a) and c:\...\be\src\http\routes\orders.ts (GET /orders/:id read-only, ORDER_NOT_FOUND 404).

Create c:\...\be\src\domain\coupons.ts: genCode() matching ^SAVE-[A-Z0-9]{6}$; generateCoupon (eligibleMilestone = floor(orders.size / n) * n using orders.size per F2; 0 -> NO_MILESTONE_REACHED 409; already in generatedMilestones -> MILESTONE_ALREADY_REWARDED 409; else create available coupon + add milestone), and reserve/release/redeem helpers implementing available->reserved->redeemed with NO reservedBy field (F4). Wire reserve/redeem/release into checkout.ts. Create c:\...\be\src\http\routes\admin.ts with POST /admin/coupons/generate and GET /admin/coupons returning {code,percentOff,milestone,status} (NIT b).

Create c:\...\be\src\domain\reporting.ts: a FULLY SYNCHRONOUS buildReport(store,config) obeying rule R-REPORT-SYNC -- read orders, coupons, config, counter into locals with NO await anywhere, then compute ordersPlaced=orders.size (F2), milestonesReached=floor(ordersPlaced/n), purchasedQuantityByProduct, grossRevenueCents, totalDiscountsCents, netRevenueCents, coupons{generated,available,reserved,redeemed}, config. Add GET /admin/report to admin.ts; the async handler must perform no await between the builder's internal reads (it just calls buildReport then replies).

Add per-module integration tests via app.inject with a fresh buildApp per test, creating carts via the API and capturing returned ids: test/carts.test.ts (add/sum/update/remove/view totals; invalid product 404; invalid qty 400), test/checkout.test.ts (happy 201 + order snapshot explains itself; CART_EMPTY 422; INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY 409; same-key idempotent retry -> one order + 200 replay; header-less same-coupon replay vs different-coupon 409), test/coupons.test.ts (generate at milestone 201; generate again MILESTONE_ALREADY_REWARDED; before milestone NO_MILESTONE_REACHED; checkout applies discount + redeems), test/report.test.ts (reconciliation identities after several orders incl. a discounted one).
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run test/carts.test.ts test/checkout.test.ts test/coupons.test.ts test/report.test.ts` passes.

Checkout route calls executor.run with no preceding await (NIT a); GET /admin/coupons returns status (NIT b); buildReport is synchronous with no await (F1); order count derives from orders.size with milestoneSequence set after insert (F2); fingerprint is cartId|couponCode (F3); no reservedBy anywhere (F4); carts/orders use randomUUID (F5).
server.ts starts a seeded server via `npm run dev` / `npm start`.
verification: Run `npx vitest run test/carts.test.ts test/checkout.test.ts test/coupons.test.ts test/report.test.ts` -- all green.
Then run `npm test` -- the whole suite so far is green.
findings:
COMPLETED. `npm run build` exits 0 (strict NodeNext). `npx vitest run test/carts.test.ts test/checkout.test.ts test/coupons.test.ts test/report.test.ts` = 23 green; full `npm test` = 45 green across 7 files. Server boots seeded: `node tsx src/server.ts` -> GET /products returns 200 with 6 seed products.

buildApp SIGNATURE (src/http/app.ts): buildApp(deps: {store: Store; config: Config; yieldHook?: YieldHook; logger?: boolean}): FastifyInstance. It creates ONE SerialExecutor internally (fresh per app) and wires all routes + the error handler. yieldHook is accepted for design-seam parity but is NOT wired to any route (design 4.2); logger defaults to false (quiet tests). Tests build a fresh app per scenario: buildApp({store: createStore(seedProducts()), config: {n,x}}). server.ts does loadConfig(process.env) -> createStore(seedProducts()) -> buildApp({..., logger:true}) -> app.listen({port: PORT||3000, host: HOST||'0.0.0.0'}); fail-fast on invalid config before listen.

ROUTE LIST (base, no prefix): GET /products; GET /products/:id (404 PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND); POST /carts (201 {id,status,lines,subtotalCents}); GET /carts/:id (CartView); POST /carts/:id/items {productId,quantity}; PATCH /carts/:id/items/:productId {quantity}; DELETE /carts/:id/items/:productId (idempotent 200); POST /carts/:id/checkout (header Idempotency-Key?, body {couponCode?}) -> 201 fresh / 200 replay with response header 'Idempotent-Replay: true'; GET /orders/:id (404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND); POST /admin/coupons/generate (201 {coupon}); GET /admin/coupons -> [{code,percentOff,milestone,status}] (NIT b); GET /admin/report -> Report (synchronous builder, F1).

RESPONSE SHAPES FEAT-003 TESTS MUST KNOW: product endpoints wrap single product as {product}. Cart endpoints return a CartView {id,status,lines:[{productId,name,unitPriceCents,quantity,lineSubtotalCents}],subtotalCents} (POST /carts returns 201). Checkout + GET /orders/:id wrap the order as {order}. GET /admin/coupons returns a BARE array (not wrapped). Error body is {error:{code,message,details?}}. Idempotent-Replay is response-only, 'true' only on 200 replay, omitted otherwise.

DOMAIN SEAMS (importable by FEAT-003 unit/integration tests): src/domain/products.ts {listProducts(store), getProduct(store,id)}; src/domain/carts.ts {createCart,addItem,updateQty,removeItem (executor-driven, return CartView), getCartView,viewCart (read-only), QUANTITY_CAP=10000}; src/domain/checkout.ts {checkout(store,executor,config,input:{cartId,couponCode,idempotencyKey}) -> Promise<{order,httpStatus:200|201,replay}>, getOrder(store,id)}; src/domain/coupons.ts {genCode():string ^SAVE-[A-Z0-9]{6}$, generateCoupon(store,executor,config), listCoupons(store), reserveCoupon(store,code), releaseCoupon(coupon), redeemCoupon(coupon,orderId)}; src/domain/reporting.ts {buildReport(store,config):Report synchronous}. HTTP route registrars: src/http/routes/{products,carts,checkout,orders,admin}.ts + src/http/error-handler.ts {registerErrorHandler(app)}.

INVARIANTS CONFIRMED IN CODE: NIT a — checkout handler returns checkout(...).then(...) with NO preceding await (no work before executor submission). NIT b — admin coupon list includes status. F1 — buildReport has zero await; admin/report handler just returns buildReport(...). F2 — ordersPlaced/milestone derive from store.orders.size; order.milestoneSequence set to store.orders.size AFTER the orders.set insert. F3 — fingerprint = `${cartId}|${couponCode ?? ''}`. F4 — no reservedBy anywhere (grep-clean). F5 — carts/orders use newId() (crypto.randomUUID); tests create carts via POST /carts and capture returned ids. Checkout key-lookup runs FIRST; coupon reserved BEFORE inventory validation; release on any pre-commit failure (verified by the INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY-with-coupon test leaving the coupon 'available'). couponCode request schema regex ^[A-Z0-9-]{1,64}$, exact case-sensitive match. DECISIONS.md / API.md were NOT part of FEAT-002 steps (left for a later doc feature); README.md untouched.
